name: feltcircle
description: FeltCircle — real cards, digital chips. A self-hostable virtual poker chip manager for in-person No-Limit Texas Hold'em.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @feltcircle/web && npm run build -w @feltcircle/server-node
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/poker-engine && tsc -p packages/chip-export && tsc -p packages/game-protocol && tsc -p packages/room-core && tsc -p packages/game-session && tsc -p packages/i18n && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p apps/server-node && tsc -p apps/server-cloudflare
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build:web && npm run deploy -w @feltcircle/server-cloudflare
